profile.headline: Software Engineer II @ Microsoft | EngOps (React Native, iOS, Android)
profile.summary:
Pursuing a Graduate degree in Financial Market Analysis and AI at Institut d'Etudis Financiers, undergrad in B.S. in Computer Science class of 2021 from Tecnológico de Monterrey. 

Currently work as a Software Engineer II at Microsoft, specializing in incident management and mobile outage solutions. My work focuses on React Native development for Android/iOS, creating APIs to enhance performance, reducing memory leaks, and improving app usability for thousands of daily users.  My contributions include developing CI/CD infrastructure for critical service-level monitors, optimizing app performance, and creating tools such as MCP servers, mobile components and scalable systems for Azure EngOps. With a strong foundation in LLMOps, iOS, and Android development, I thrive in enhancing operational efficiency and accessibility through innovative software solutions.
